answer: Exchanges prove reserves with Merkle trees that let each customer check their own balance without trusting totals. Check agents the same way: every reward is a leaf linked to a specific answer and its graders, and anyone can trace the path. Sybil profits need many leaves leading back to one funding wallet, and that ripple shows when flows are reconciled. A whisper of shared deposits across a grove of new keys is enough to hold payouts for review.
